section_summary.extract_value: Describes translation of the BSRS into Brazilian Portuguese using back-translation and committee review, recruitment of participants opportunistically from university campus locations, and lab-based completion of paper-and-pencil anonymous questionnaires. Weight and height were measured and a randomly-selected subsample of 100 participants returned after 15 days for retest; analyses were conducted using SPSS 22.0 with listwise deletion for missing data.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: "The BSRS was translated into Brazilian Portuguese using the back-translation technique..."; "participants were opportunistically recruited from various university campus locations..."; "All testing was conducted in a laboratory setting, where participants completed paper-and-pencil, anonymous questionnaires..."; "Weight, height, and bra size measurements were taken..."; "Fifteen days after the initial testing session... a randomly-selected subsample of 100 participants returned..."; "All analyses were conducted using SPSS 22.0 and missing data were handled using listwise deletion."
